fixes.explanation: Vineyards? Nice guess, but the verse doesn't say it. The Reubenites and Gadites have very large herds and flocks, and they look over Jazer and Gilead and see land suitable for livestock (Numbers 32:1). Their minds are on the animals, and I think a few of those animals would have tried to eat the grapes anyway.

False is right, baker. Moses says, “But if you do not do this, you will certainly sin against the LORD—and be assured that your sin will find you out.” (Numbers 32:23). He's talking about what happens if they don't do what they promised. The words are very plain.

Time to think it over? That's not what the text shows, baker. Moses says to build the cities and folds, but do what they promised (Numbers 32:24). Then the Gadites and Reubenites say, “Your servants will do just as our lord commands.” (Numbers 32:25). No request for time anywhere. I've stood over a cooling rack for ages deciding on a cookie, but these two tribes just give their answer.

problems.problem: The joke mentions grape juice, which is not an allowed food or an answer on the card.
“Nobody gets to slip by unnoticed” broadens Moses’ specific warning and adds that someone will notice. He says their sin will find them out if they do not do what they promised.
“Right away” and the comparison about how long the tribes take to answer add timing the text does not give.
